function_count.explanation: Two old find overloads merge to one const find_index helper.

find_index.reason: Returns first occupied same_physical match in ascending 0..31 order; const and mutable old overloads merged without semantic change. 32 sentinel replaces nullptr.

empty_index.reason: Returns first ref.id==NONE in ascending order; excluded defaults32, and QKV uses first index exclusion.

claim_index.reason: First existing physical record, else first empty; checks sentinel before reference; valid/readers/state/max-epoch/exact next-epoch checks unchanged and read-only.

full_claim_owner.reason: Request/model and legal-spec gates, QKV prohibition, claim/fill/count/type/attention cleanup order unchanged.

full_check_fill_owner.reason: Missing index returns same E_BUFFER before dereference; spec/state/identity checks unchanged.

full_check_uncovered_owner.reason: Adds explicit sentinel failure after prior successful fill-owner check. Existing logical path unchanged; coverage read-only.

full_claim_qkv_pair.reason: Computes both claims before writes. When both choose same empty record, second uses first different empty. Missing/equal indices reject before fill/count/coverage clears. Preserves original fallback semantics exactly; no new epoch policy introduced.

full_cover_qkv.reason: Both shard records checked before any coverage write; index guards replace null guards.

full_publish_qkv_pair.reason: Both records/spec/state/identity and complete planes/heads/rows checked before updates; covered bits, states, valid flags, final refs retain order.

full_begin_qkv_rope_pair.reason: Both shards fully validated including readers/max epoch/identity/coverage before first lease mutation; lease_old_ref, next ref, state, bits and count ordering unchanged.

full_cover_qkv_rope.reason: Both shard checks and all duplicate-row checks occur before coverage writes; lease_old_ref and content checks retained.

full_commit_qkv_rope_pair.reason: Both records and all RoPE coverage checked before mutations; lease clearing and final refs unchanged.

full_cover_att_head.reason: Missing index guard before readonly reference; full duplicate scan precedes row writes.

full_publish_att.reason: All head/batch coverage checked before covered rows/state/valid updates.

full_require_owner.reason: Request/model/spec/scope plus identity/valid/READY-or-READ checks unchanged; no writes.

full_acquire_owner.reason: Require-owner gate then missing index and UINT8_MAX readers refusal; increment/state update unchanged.

full_release_read_owner.reason: Missing/spec/state/readers/valid refusal preserved before decrement; zero readers returns READY.

full_cover_owner.reason: Missing index returned before type_extend evaluation; removes only redundant pointer truth test. All row checks precede writes.

full_publish_owner.reason: QKV/ATT exclusions, TYPE_ROWS extension checks, nonempty mask and coverage requirements unchanged; type_valid/state/valid writes same order.

full_invalidate_owner.reason: Current or lease_old_ref may match; READ/readers refusal still precedes state/valid/lease/coverage mutation.

full_begin_inplace_owner.reason: Allowed operations, same physical scope, full coverage, max epoch and exact next epoch preserved; all reject conditions precede lease updates.

full_consume_inplace_rows.reason: Spec/state/lease/identity plus duplicate/coverage checks preserved; full check loop precedes consume writes.

full_commit_inplace_owner.reason: Spec/state/identity and both old-consumed/new coverage checks precede READY/valid/lease clear.

full_owner_snapshot.reason: Check-ref and missing/exact-ref failure preserved; output assigned only on success.

full_recycle_request.reason: Full busy/readers scan precedes all writes. Numeric-only valid A8 creates first empty or rejects before writes. Existing owner plus numeric ref chooses maximum epoch; owner-only retained. Remainder of invalidation/coverage/counters/refs/numeric reset/request-gate code is unchanged.

full_soft_reset.reason: Byte-identical function: reject zero/nonincreasing generation, recycle first, then update generation/session and reset accepted request high-water.

pointer_structure.note: Source form avoids nullable or dynamically selected record pointer results; local references are formed only after sentinel guards. Actual lowered IR/HLS acceptance still required.

test_cases: QKV selects two distinct initial empty records
Failed second QKV claim leaves first epoch and claims unchanged
Successful recycle preserves accepted request high-water
Numeric-only A8 with table exhausted refuses without claims/coverage/numeric changes
Numeric-only A8 creates first available owner and preserves history
Owner-only A8 claim/recycle advances and restores numeric high-water
Both A8 refs: either higher owner or higher numeric epoch wins
Soft reset increments generation, clears request high-water, preserves A8 epochs
limitations: Pilot exercises a subset of public owner paths and only the observed fields.
HLS may eliminate control fields absent from its dynamic dataflow; a complete Runtime type declaration is not full initializer-path evidence.
The test checks status codes and selected persistent fields, not every error detail byte or all metadata.
No RTL co-simulation result at this source-review stage.

coverage_decision.reason: same_physical/qkv_rope_specs/fill_record/full_soft_reset are byte-identical, and existing full_owner_tb has explicit alias and lease coverage. Preserve those tests in the new-build-tag complete CPU gate; do not replace with the 26-check pilot.

existing_required_cases.scope: WI/DEC_FF same physical lock and monotonic shared epoch
QKV RAW to FINAL paired lease transition
inplace lease operation and invalid transition
soft reset preserves shared WI/DEC_FF history

run_limit: Owner synthesis-host peak_owned_rss_kb=0 means live RSS was not captured for its 0.176s process. Vitis CSim exits0 but HLS synthesis/IR review remains pending.
